description: Verify pasted SERP or AI-answer text, or one caller-provided public URL, against retrieved sources. Use this when an agent needs a confirm, contradict, or missing verdict with cited sources before quoting or paying for evidence. Returns the verdict plus sources with URLs, retrieval timestamps, and content hashes; on unreachable sources returns a structured error (source_unavailable) instead of a verdict. Creates one immutable job record per call (a side effect); may fetch the single caller-provided URL and never spends. For example, paste an AI answer claiming a token launch date to check it against live sources.

serp_text_or_url.description: Pasted SERP/AI text or one public URL to verify (1-60000 chars). No Google scraping is performed; only caller-supplied text or the single provided URL is used.

name: aftersearch_verify_serp

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.

title: Aftersearch Verify Serp
